notes:
New
- Galleries: share chosen photos as a gallery link, with an optional password, from Outputs › Galleries or Share as gallery…
- Meki on the web: turn on “Show this library on the web” to browse, cull and organise your library at app.mekiphoto.com, and see Signed-in browsers in Settings
- Photo variants: RAW + JPEG pairs, exports and edits join their photo as one tile, with a cover, a Variants tab and Combine
- Keep originals on this Mac per project, by status, and Offline Mode, which keeps Meki off the internet
- Originals Meki can fetch from Meki Cloud or a connected drive show a cloud mark, and come here when opened or zoomed to 100%
- Lightroom and Phocus open photos through hand-off folders beside the catalog, and finals land in the Edited tree
- Lossless finals as JPEG XL from Lightroom Classic, with HDR finals shown and zoomed in HDR in the loupe
- A second editor (Photoshop and others) with Edit in app name and ⌥⌘E; its saves come back to Meki
- Revert to Original, with counts and Undo
- Focus points in the Info panel and the loupe, with a Focus missed filter; Content Credentials in the Info panel
- IPTC fields, and an Info panel you arrange in Settings
- Meki Cloud backups of the catalog, with Restore an earlier version from the Cloud button

Improved
- Imports can go straight to the archive or pass through this Mac to Meki Cloud, in batches when they don't fit
- While an import copies, background tasks wait so Meki focuses on importing; Meki keeps the Mac awake (Settings › Storage › This Mac › Sleep)
- The task list sorts by priority, pauses one task or a whole activity, and explains a task that failed or needs you
- Big albums open and scroll faster: the grid pages its photos in as you scroll
- The Instagram editor and Prints board paint the photos in view first; new templates and a Crop detail template
- Select several albums and drag them onto a project; reorder albums by dragging their tabs or sidebar rows
- Archived projects take drops and moves, and are listed last
- Meki Journal sync checks only projects that changed, so culling with a phone nearby stays light
- Catalog reads no longer hold up the screen: lighter background passes and more memory given back to macOS
- Sign in with Apple

Fixed
- Stars, flags and labels go both ways with Lightroom; Lightroom's changes come back on focus and Sync
- A cancelled Meki Journal Cloud sync stops at once
- Smaller fixes across tasks, import, archive, the loupe, Lightroom Classic, editors and Meki Cloud
